powercheck (9, 9)
# v12 energy per delivered flit (Noxim power model; generated by experiments_v12.py)

-power on vs off: 9 / 9 runs with identical summary blocks (latency, throughput, energy).

Uniform, fault-free; mean over seeds 41-43; 10000 cycles with warm-up 0 (energy and delivered flits over the same interval). pJ per delivered flit; in brackets: % against DeFT(rho*). Static energy is charged to every router every cycle, so its share per flit falls with the delivered traffic; the RC buffer is not modelled.
